articles.title: Malaysia Set to Hold Rates on Strong Growth, Signal Hike in 2027
articles.summary: Malaysia’s central bank is expected to keep interest rates unchanged at its final policy meeting of the year on Thursday while signaling scope for a hike early in 2027 as economic growth remains strong.
